text:
taylor.marketing: Quick prioritized ask for launch comms: can runtime run a targeted rerun we can cite in the blog + webinar? Need conservative p50/p95/p99 and a coldstart heatmap. cc @sam.runtime @eli.eng

sam.runtime: Sure. Clarify: cohort size, quant candidate name, baseline, slices, and deliverables? Also do you need forced-batching off slice?

taylor.marketing: Cohort N=48. Quant candidate: q4_2-lite. Baseline: fp16. Use marketing-samplepack-v3 and include long-context (seq_len>2500) + interactive slices. Deliverables: 1) CSV with p50/p95/p99 per-slice + bootstrap CIs, 2) cost estimate $/1M tokens (method note), 3) coldstart heatmap PNG, 4) 15 anonymized raw traces, 5) run_config.json, 6) one-paragraph methods blurb. Seed=2024. Cache: ON for main run (prod-like) plus a short cache=OFF coldstart slice (--warmup 0, N=10). If possible include a forced-batching=off slice (N=20) for single-request numbers. Put artifacts in /share/marketing/benchpacks/1765009999/ and mark as embargoed until launch. Deadline: Monday 10:00 PT.

eli.eng: Noted. Also want to flag that q4_2-lite shows variance in >3k tokens; we'll include bootstrap CIs and a delta vs baseline column. Which tokenizer?

taylor.marketing: Tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v5. Model redwood-alpha-8k@rev29. Please scrub traces and replace any user IDs with pseudonyms.

sam.runtime: Plan: prioritized enqueue tomorrow 05:00 UTC. We'll run cohort=mini48 seed=2024 model=redwood-alpha-8k@rev29 tokenizer=rwd-tokenizer-v5 variants="q4_2-lite,fp16" context=8192 batching=auto cache=on tags=marketing,embargoed,priority. Then two short slices: (A) cache=off --warmup 0 N=10; (B) batching=off N=20. We'll compute bootstrap CIs (N=1000) and cost using internal-pricing-2026 and include assumptions. ETA runtime ~2h. If queue pressure, we'll run a 1h prioritized pass (N=30) for percentiles + heatmap and backfill traces later.

sam.runtime: Command (what we'll enqueue):
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini48 --seed 2024 --model redwood-alpha-8k@rev29 --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v5 --variants "q4_2-lite,fp16" --context 8192 --batching auto --cache on --tags marketing,embargoed,priority
```

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #4120 by sam.runtime  status: waiting for runners (https://rundashboard/jobs/4120)

sam.runtime: We'll annotate artifacts with per-host warmup counts and include a pseudonym map for traces. We'll also attach run_config.json, methods.txt, and a short PNG suitable for slide import.

lee.metrics: I will sanity-check cost calculations and confirm bootstrap CI methodology. If p95 CI overlaps baseline, we'll recommend conservative wording for the blog.

taylor.marketing: Awesome 44f. Please tag me when artifacts land. If the full run can't finish by the deadline, the prioritized N=30 pass is acceptable as a fallback for rehearsal. Thanks all! :rocket:
